title: Referrals
description: Track every referral from submission to hire: candidates you sent to partner jobs, and candidates partners sent to yours.

sent.title: No referrals sent yet
sent.description: When a partner job fits one of your candidates, submit them from Suggestions. You'll follow their progress here.

received.title: No referrals received yet
received.description: Publish a job open to partners. Recruiters with matching candidates can then submit them to you.

detail.title: Referral
detail.submittedFlash: Submitted. {partner} has been notified and can now see only the fields you approved.
detail.revoked: The candidate's sharing authorization was revoked on {date}.
detail.revokedTarget: The shared profile and documents are no longer available to you.
detail.revokedSource: The partner no longer has access to the shared profile or documents.
detail.guidanceTarget: Review the approved profile, then decide. Feedback must be job-related and non-discriminatory.
detail.guidanceSource: Keep the partner updated. Withdrawing stops their access to further documents.
detail.disclosed: Disclosed fields: {fields}. Shared on {date}. Later edits to the candidate's profile aren't shared.

agreement.title: Collaboration agreement
agreement.pending: Created automatically from the current commission rule when the hiring recruiter accepts. The split is frozen after that.
agreement.internal: Internal referral: both organizations share a member, so there's no sourcing commission. The hiring recruiter keeps that share; the platform fee is unchanged.
agreement.pendingSnapshot: Created when the hiring recruiter accepts, from this referral's terms and the split in force when it was submitted. The split is frozen for this referral.
agreement.deemedLine: Created on {date} from the terms and split frozen at submission, because the hire was recorded before the agreement was confirmed.
agreement.none: No agreement: the hire was recorded without a split.

fit.title: Fit with the job
fit.hint: Indicative score, frozen when the candidate was submitted.

next.waitingBody: You'll be notified as soon as they update this referral.
next.hired: Hired · the placement is now tracked in Commissions.
next.awaitingSent: Email sent to {email} {time}. The link expires on {date}. {partner} only sees the referral after confirmation.
next.awaitingNotSent: The email to {email} has not been sent yet.
next.awaitingExpired: The link sent to {email} expired on {date}. Resend to create a new one.
next.candidateDeclinedBody: {partner} was not notified and never had access to any information.
next.alreadyPresentedBody: The candidate confirmed, but they had already been presented to {partner} for this client, so this referral wasn't delivered. {partner} can't see it, and nothing was shared with them.
next.claimFiledSourceBody: {partner} says they already had this candidate for this client. Review the objection below. You can contest it until {when} ET.
next.hiredNoSplitTargetReleased: This referral doesn't carry a split.
next.hiredNoSplitTargetNoAgreement: No placement: the referral had no confirmed agreement.
next.hiredNoSplitSource: {partner} recorded a hire on {date}. No placement was created.
next.hiredNoSplitSourceRule: The referral had no confirmed agreement. If you believe a share is owed, Network Rules 7.5 sets out the next steps.
next.voidSource: A platform admin found the candidate's confirmation invalid.

detail.awaitingFlash: Referral created. We emailed {email}; it will be delivered to {partner} as soon as the candidate confirms.
detail.awaitingNotSentFlash: Referral created, but the email to the candidate was not sent. Use “Resend email” below.
detail.ownershipNotDelivered: This referral wasn't delivered, so it holds no ownership.
detail.ownershipReleased: Released on {date}. This referral no longer holds ownership for this client.
detail.ownershipEnded: No ownership: the prior-presentation objection on this referral was upheld or became final.
detail.legacyDuplicateHint: Recorded before evidence was required. No objection or contest is possible.

claimRejected.target: Objection rejected on {date}. A platform admin decided the prior-presentation objection wasn't valid. Review this referral again: accept it, or decline it for another reason.
claimRejected.source: Objection rejected on {date}. This referral is back with {partner} for review.

terms.title: Terms
terms.newerOnJob: This job's terms are now version {current}. This referral keeps version {version}.
terms.newerOnJobAmended: This job's terms are now version {current}. This referral keeps its amended terms.

ownershipStartsAtDelivery.one: Ownership starts when the referral is delivered: {count} month with this client.
ownershipStartsAtDelivery.other: Ownership starts when the referral is delivered: {count} months with this client.

detail.protectedUntil: Protected while in progress and until {date} ET.
detail.protectedUnlessReleased: Protected while in progress and until {date} ET, unless the sourcing recruiter released the candidate.
detail.closedStaleOwn: Closed by MissionHub: no activity for 60 days after your organization was removed from the network.
detail.closedStalePartner: Closed by MissionHub after a long period with no activity.

actions.declineHint: Share job-related, non-discriminatory feedback. It will be visible to the partner recruiter.
actions.noteHint: Your note is recorded in the referral timeline and visible to the partner.

agreement.title: Confirm the collaboration agreement?
agreement.description: You agree to the commission split shown, frozen for this referral. Template terms are a draft pending legal review; confirm your own contractual obligations separately.
agreement.descriptionSnapshot: These are this referral's terms. They can't be changed for this referral unless both organizations ask MissionHub in writing before a hire. The network rules are a draft pending legal review.

hire.title: Record a hire
hire.description: Creates the placement from the fee, currency and guarantee you enter. Commission stays projected until the client's payment is verified.
hire.descriptionSnapshot: Creates the placement from this referral's terms. Commission stays projected until the client's payment is verified.
hire.baseHint: From the accepted offer. Both organizations see this amount; the candidate doesn't.
hire.bonusHint: Annual target bonus in the offer. Enter 0 if there's none. Don't include equity, signing bonus, benefits or relocation.
hire.invoicedHint: This hire's fee to the client, retainer included. Don't include other services.
hire.noteHint: Both organizations see this note. Don't include candidate names or contact details.
hire.lowerConsequence: {partner}'s share stays based on the computed fee, so your share covers the difference and can go below zero. {partner} is notified.
hire.higherConsequence: Shares are never calculated on less than the computed fee. When you invoice more, every share follows the invoiced fee. {partner} is notified.
hire.legacyDescription: This referral was sent before the terms card. Enter the fee, currency and guarantee as agreed with {partner}.

validation.acceptanceAfterStart: The acceptance date must be on or before the start date
validation.acceptanceFuture: Enter a date that isn't in the future
validation.otherRoleTitle: Enter the job title (120 characters or fewer)

hire.anyStatusNote: This referral's status is {status}. You can still record the hire: the referral's terms apply.
hire.acceptanceUnknown: I don't know the acceptance date
hire.startUsedForTiming: We'll use the start date to check the timing.
hire.otherRoleHint: The title of the role they were hired into. Don't add candidate details. The fee uses this referral's terms and the salary for this role.
hire.objectionOpenTitle: Your objection on this referral is still open
hire.objectionOpenBody: You can record the hire once your prior-presentation objection is decided. If it's upheld, this referral no longer counts.
hire.deemedTitle: This referral has no confirmed agreement
hire.deemedBody: Recording the hire creates the agreement from the terms {partner} submitted under (version {version}, {date}) and the split frozen then. {partner} is told and doesn't need to confirm.
hire.deemedBodyLegacy: Recording the hire creates the agreement from the split in force when {partner} submitted this referral. {partner} is told and doesn't need to confirm.
hire.noAgreementBody: This referral has no confirmed agreement, so the hire is recorded for both organizations without a split.
hire.noAgreementTermsLine: This referral was sent under terms version {version} ({date}).
hire.recordOnlyResult: This referral doesn't carry a split. No placement was created.
hire.noAgreementResult: No placement was created, because the referral had no confirmed agreement. {partner} was told.
hire.nonPermanentHint: Contractor, PJ, EOR, payroll-provider, affiliate and other-agency engagements count as hires. The referral's terms still set {partner}'s share unless {partner} agreed in writing beforehand.

message.label: Message
message.placeholder: Professional, job-related messages only. Visible to both recruiters.

form.step1Body: Only the fields you check are copied into the shared profile {recipient} sees. Your private notes and the original profile are never shared.
form.authAfter: . A resume upload alone does not authorize sharing.
form.legalBasisHint: Draft options — confirm with privacy counsel.
form.evidenceHint: e.g. 'Candidate approved by email on 2026-11-06 after reviewing the role summary.'
form.confirmInterest: I confirmed the candidate is interested in this specific role and approved sharing the selected information.
form.notePlaceholder: Context for the hiring recruiter: motivation, notice period, why this is a fit…
form.anonymous: The candidate stays anonymous to the partner unless you add identifying fields.
form.revocation: If the authorization is revoked later, the partner immediately loses access to the shared profile and documents.
form.methodEmail: Ask the candidate to confirm by email
form.methodEmailHint: We email a private link to {email}. The referral stays “Awaiting candidate approval” and is delivered to {partner} automatically once they confirm. Through the link, the candidate can also update their own profile.
form.methodEmailMissing: No email on the candidate's profile. Add one to ask for confirmation.
form.methodRecorded: I already have the candidate's authorization
form.methodRecordedHint: Record how and when the candidate authorized it (e.g. by phone). MissionHub uses the candidate's contact details to check for duplicate referrals.
form.duplicateCheckNote: MissionHub checks the candidate's contact details to make sure they weren't already presented to {partner} for this client.

identifierRequired.title: Add contact details to submit
identifierRequired.description: Every referral needs at least one way to reach the candidate: an email, a full phone number with area code, or a LinkedIn profile.

form.termsLineConfirm: These terms apply even if the candidate confirms later.

validation.selectField: Select at least one field to share
validation.confirmInterest: Confirm the candidate is interested in this role
validation.describeAuthorization: Describe how the candidate authorized sharing with this recruiter for this job
validation.attestationRequired: Confirm the statement to file the objection.
validation.evidenceRequired: Upload at least one file, or pick an earlier referral
validation.invoicedSame: Enter a different amount, or untick “Invoiced fee is different”
validation.noteRequiredOther: Add a note to explain the difference
validation.noteTooLong: Keep the note to 500 characters or fewer

errors.opportunityGone: This opportunity is no longer available.
errors.candidateEmailFailed: We couldn't email the candidate. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.emailNotConfigured: Email delivery is not configured in this environment.

success.statusUpdated: Status updated. The partner has been notified.
success.agreementConfirmed: Agreement confirmed. Commission terms are now frozen for this referral.
success.withdrawn: Referral withdrawn. It keeps first position for this client until {date}.
success.contested: Objection contested. A platform admin will review it.

caughtUp.title: All caught up
caughtUp.description: No referrals waiting for a decision. New ones appear here and in your notifications.

queue.selectHint: Select rows to decline several at once
queue.noScore: No fit score for this referral
queue.revokedLong: The candidate revoked sharing. The profile and documents are no longer available.
queue.noMessages: No messages yet. Open the full page to write one.
queue.declineHint: The partner sees the reason. Keep it job-related.
queue.infoTitle: Ask the partner for more information
queue.infoHint: The referral pauses until the partner answers.
queue.infoPlaceholder: e.g. Can you share their notice period and recent projects?

done.accepted: Accepted. The collaboration agreement was created.

claimCallout.title: Already had this candidate for this client?
claimCallout.description: Decline with a prior-presentation objection and dated evidence. You can do this until {when} ET.

queue.bulkClaimHint: To file a prior-presentation objection, open one referral at a time.

received.title: Referrals received
received.description: Candidates partner recruiters submitted to your open jobs. Review each one and move them forward or decline.

sent.title: Referrals sent
sent.description: Your candidates submitted to partner recruiters' jobs, from submission to hire.

pipeline.title: Pipeline
pipeline.description: Move accepted candidates through your hiring process, from acceptance to hire.

composer.skillsVsJob: Checked against the job's required skills
composer.shareHint: Use the eye on each section to share or hide it. Only what's shared is copied into the shared profile.
composer.restrictedHold: You can't submit referrals while your organization is on a network hold.
composer.restrictedRules: You can't submit referrals until an organization admin accepts the current Network Rules.
composer.userMustAccept: Accept Network Rules {label} to submit referrals.

duplicate.pendingTitle: This candidate may already be in process with {partner}
duplicate.pendingDescription: Another referral for this candidate is waiting for the candidate to confirm it. You can still submit. If the other referral reaches {partner} first, this one is closed and {partner} won't receive it.
duplicate.acknowledge: I understand and want to submit this referral anyway.
duplicate.message: This candidate has already been presented to {partner} for this client, so this referral can't be submitted. This rule only decides which referral counts for the commission. It doesn't stop {partner} from hiring the candidate.
duplicate.stopNext: Nothing was sent to the candidate or to {partner}.

withdraw.title: Withdraw this referral?
withdraw.description: {partner} is notified. Withdrawing doesn't give up your first position: until {date}, no other partner can submit this candidate to {partner} for this client through MissionHub.
withdraw.release: Also release this candidate for this client
withdraw.releaseHint: Other partners can then submit this candidate to {partner} for this client. This referral gives up its first position.
withdraw.releaseConfirmTitle: Release this candidate for this client?
withdraw.releaseConfirmDescription: Your referral will be withdrawn and give up its first position. Other partners can then submit this candidate to {partner} for this client. You can't undo this.

release.title: Release this candidate for this client?
release.description: This referral is closed but still holds first position for this client until {date}. If you release the candidate, other partners can submit them to {partner} for this client.
release.confirmDescription: This referral gives up its first position for this client for good. {partner} isn't notified. You can't undo this.

claim.title: File a prior-presentation objection
claim.description: Filing an objection declines this referral with the reason “Prior presentation”. {partner} sees the dates, the type of evidence and your note, but not your files. They have 10 business days to contest. If they do, a platform admin reviews your evidence.
claim.evidenceFileHint: An ATS export, or an email saved as PDF or image, that shows the candidate in process with this client.
claim.evidenceReferralHint: A referral you received for this job or this client before this one.
claim.evidenceReferralNone: No earlier referral for this job or client can be used.
claim.filesHint: PDF, PNG or JPEG. Up to 5 files, 10 MB each.
claim.uploadDeadline: Objection deadline: {when} ET · {left}. Files must finish processing and the objection must be filed by then.

file.rejected: This file can't be used. Remove it to continue.

waiting.one: Waiting for {count} file to finish processing
waiting.other: Waiting for {count} files to finish processing

file.removeRejected: To continue, remove the file that can't be used
file.retryOrRemove: To continue, try the upload again or remove the file

claim.priorDate: Date the candidate was last in process with this client
claim.priorDateHint: Between {from} and {to} (before this referral was delivered).
claim.priorDateFromReferral: Date used: {date}, the day the earlier referral was delivered.
claim.noteHint: {partner} sees this note. Don't include client names or contact details.
claim.attestation: I confirm this objection and its evidence are true and accurate. I understand that false objections can get my organization suspended from MissionHub.

validation.evidenceRequired: Upload at least one file, or pick an earlier referral
validation.priorDateAfterDelivery: Enter a date before {date}, when this referral was delivered

priorDateTooOld.one: Enter a date on or after {date} ({count} month before delivery)
priorDateTooOld.other: Enter a date on or after {date} ({count} months before delivery)

validation.attestationRequired: Confirm the statement to file the objection
validation.fileType: Upload a PDF, PNG or JPEG file
validation.fileSize: Upload files of 10 MB or less

messages.filed: Objection filed. {partner} can contest it until {when} ET.

panel.title: Prior-presentation objection
panel.priorDate: Candidate last in process with this client
panel.filesHiddenSource: Only {partner} can open these files, and platform admins if you contest. The SHA-256 shows that a file hasn't changed since it was uploaded.

status.openTarget: {partner} can contest this objection until {when} ET.
status.openSource: You can contest this objection until {when} ET. Contesting is free: a platform admin reviews the evidence.
status.contested: Contested on {date}. A platform admin is reviewing the objection.
status.upheld: Upheld by a platform admin on {date}.
status.rejected: Rejected by a platform admin on {date}.

priorDateWindowHint.one: This referral's ownership window is {count} month, so you can go back {count} month.
priorDateWindowHint.other: This referral's ownership window is {count} months, so you can go back {count} months.

contest.title: Contest this objection?
contest.description: A platform admin reviews the objection and its evidence, then upholds or rejects it. Contesting is free. You and {partner} are both notified of the decision.
contest.reason: Why do you disagree with the objection?
contest.reasonHint: Only MissionHub platform admins read this. {partner} doesn't see it. Don't include client names or contact details.

messages.contested: Objection contested. A platform admin will review it.

termsChanged.title: The terms for this job changed
termsChanged.description: {partner} published new terms on {date}. Nothing was sent. Review the changes marked below, then submit again.

hireReport.limit: You can report a hire until {date}.
hireReport.limitTail: You can report a hire until {date} if the client's selection process started before {windowEnd}.

messages.filed: Hire report filed. {partner} has until {when} ET to answer.

validation.employer: Enter the employer (200 characters or fewer)
validation.itemDate: Enter a date that isn't in the future
validation.capturedBefore: The capture date can't be before the item's date
validation.link: Enter a link that starts with https://
validation.tail: Confirm when the process started and mark the item that shows it
validation.learnedVia: Choose how you learned of it
validation.role: Use 120 characters or fewer for the role

hireReport.title: Report a hire to {partner}
hireReport.description: Tell {partner} you believe the client hired this candidate. {partner} sees your statement, the employer and the dates of your evidence. Only MissionHub admins see files and links. {partner} has 10 business days to answer. While the report is pending, you can't release this candidate for this client.
hireReport.tailStatement: The client's selection process that led to this hire (first interview or assessment) started before {windowEnd}.
hireReport.tailHint: Mark at least one evidence item that shows when the process started.

item.backsTail: This item shows when the process started
item.linkHint: Starts with https://. Only MissionHub admins see it.

hireReport.evidenceHint: Add at least one dated item.
hireReport.weightHint: A screenshot with no link or date is accepted, but it counts for less.
hireReport.filesHint: PDF, PNG or JPEG. Up to 5 files, 10 MB each. Only MissionHub admins see them. {partner} sees when each was uploaded and its SHA-256.
hireReport.statementHint: What you know and how you know it. {partner} reads this. 20–2000 characters.
hireReport.attestation: I confirm this report is true and complete to the best of my knowledge (Network Rules 4.8).

file.waiting: Wait until every file is checked.
file.removeRejected: Remove the file that can't be used.

hireReport.unavailableHint: If you have a question for {partner}, write in the referral messages.
hireReport.rightToolUnavailable: Hire reports are filed from the referral, with dated evidence, while it still counts. Otherwise, write to {org} in the referral messages.

panel.title: Hire report
panel.tailMade: The sourcing recruiter stated that the selection process started before {windowEnd}.
panel.linksHidden: Only {partner} and MissionHub admins can see the links.
panel.filesHidden: Only {partner} and MissionHub admins can see the files.
panel.releasePaused: While this report is pending, you can't release this candidate for this client.

status.awaitingTarget: Answer by {when} ET: confirm and record the hire, or contest it.
status.unansweredTarget: The answer deadline has passed. A platform admin is reviewing the report. You can still record the hire.
status.unansweredSource: {partner} didn't answer by the deadline. A platform admin is reviewing the report.
status.contestedTarget: Contested. {partner} can add a rebuttal until {when} ET. Then a platform admin decides.
status.contestedSource: {partner} contested this report. You can add one rebuttal until {when} ET.
status.inReview: A platform admin is reviewing the report.
status.closedByRecordTarget: Closed: you recorded the hire on {date}.
status.closedByRecordSource: Closed: the hiring recruiter confirmed the hire on {date}.
status.deemedTarget: Confirmed on {date}: no answer by the deadline, after the notice reached two people at {org} by email. Enter the fee details by {when} ET.
status.deemedSource: Confirmed on {date}: {partner} didn't answer by the deadline.
status.upheld: Upheld by a platform admin on {date}. The hire counts.
status.rejected: Not upheld by a platform admin on {date}.
status.voidTarget: Closed by a platform admin on {date}. This referral no longer counts.
status.voidSource: Closed on {date}: a platform admin found the candidate's confirmation invalid. This referral no longer counts.

messages.contested: Report contested. {partner} can add a rebuttal until {when} ET.

validation.dates: Enter both dates. The process can't start after the offer was accepted.

hireContest.title: Contest this hire report?
hireContest.description: A platform admin decides on the record. {partner} can add one rebuttal within 5 business days. A false contest breaks Network Rules 4.8.
hireContest.noPriorHint: “We already had this candidate” isn't a reason here. That was the objection, within 5 business days of delivery.
hireContest.processHint: The first interview or assessment for the role they were hired into.
hireContest.statementHint: {partner} reads this. Don't name your client.
hireContest.filesHint: Only MissionHub admins see these. For example, the client's written statement, shared with the client's permission.
hireContest.attestation: I confirm this contest is true and complete to the best of my knowledge (Network Rules 4.8).

messages.sent: Rebuttal sent. A platform admin will decide.

hireRebuttal.title: Add your rebuttal
hireRebuttal.description: You can add one rebuttal. After that, a platform admin decides on the record.

authCheck.sentLine: Evidence sent on {date}. A platform admin is reviewing it.
authCheck.requestTitle: Ask MissionHub to check the candidate's authorization?
authCheck.requestBody: A platform admin checks whether the candidate really agreed to be presented by {partner}. Only admins read your reason.
authCheck.title: Authorization check
authCheck.body: MissionHub needs independent evidence that the candidate agreed to be represented by you. For example, the candidate's dated message from a channel other than the confirmation email. If nothing is sent by the deadline, the referral may stop counting.
authCheck.attestation: I confirm this evidence is genuine (Network Rules 4.8).
